Portfolio or creative agency landing pages

ai_summary: An elegant hero component featuring multiple animated floating shapes with glass-morphism effects and gradient styling. Shapes animate into view with smooth fade and slide transitions, then continuously float with subtle vertical motion. Includes backdrop blur, soft glow effects, and radial gradient overlays for a premium, modern aesthetic suitable for landing pages.
